text:
Maya: Quick follow-up to the ingress retry telemetry RFC. Proposal: add a tiny 'plumbline' shim in the gateway that emits synthetic retry lifecycle events so observability can stitch midstream attempts. Minimal event fields: ingress_id, attempt, token_index, reason, trace_id, resume_handshake. No payloads.

Chris: OK for telemetry, but keep API boundary internal. We should avoid changing upstream headers by default. If we need client visibility later, add an opt-in hint header.

Devin: Sampling is crucial. For high-QPS customers start at 0.1% global, with anomaly-triggered upsampling. Include trace id/session id to correlate logs.

Samir: Use x-rd-trace header if present else gateway-generated trace. Event example (stringified in logs): {ingress_id:abc123, attempt:2, event:retry_start, token_index:2048, reason:upstream-reset, trace_id:t-xyz, ts:1680000000}.

Katie: Clarify token_index semantics: token-level index relative to request start. Add model_name and sequence_length so downstream can interpret.

Devin: Also include resume_handshake boolean when we can resume streaming rather than restart. Add fallback_model when we switch variants.

OpsBot: Est: current retry rate ~2%. With 0.1% sampling this is ~0.002 events/request. Monitor kafka backpressure; implement per-tenant disable flag.

Maya: Privacy: explicitly no prompt content. If customers want more, only allow hashed context IDs under opt-in.

Chris: Implementation note: plumbline handler runs after the retry decision. Emit asynchronously with bounded queue/backpressure. Pseudocode: if should_retry(req): emit_event_async({ingress_id,attempt,token_index,reason,trace_id,model}); initiate_retry();

Devin: Tests: unit for no-content leakage, integration with telemetry pipeline, load test for event throughput.

Maya: Rollout plan: feature flag gateway.plumbline=false by default, enable 0.1% for internal tenants, then increase if stable. Create RFC follow-up issue.

Chris: I'll create kafka topic telemetry.gateway.retries.v1 with 7d retention and set up OTLP ingestion.

Samir: Add runbook entries: how to disable per-tenant and how to troubleshoot stuck queues.

Maya: Thanks everyone — I'll open the PR with schema, flag, and a tiny sim harness. :thumbsup:

OpsBot: Created issue: https://redwood.internal/issue/ARC-7621
